name: Grilled stream fish
summary: Vietnam Airlines says small stream fish are marinated with forest leaves and grilled. VnExpress adds mắc khén, chili, and lemongrass, and a separate soup of fish with măng chua. The price is Check on arrival.
origin: Vietnam Airlines travel guide, and VnExpress, Xuân Mạnh, 3 Jul 2023.
taste: Vietnam Airlines says the grilled fish is fragrant and crisp. VnExpress says the stream fish is sweet.
howToEat: Grilled, as both accounts print it. VnExpress also wraps the grilled fish with forest greens, fresh rice noodles, cucumber, and carrot, and a sweet-sour fish sauce.
The same VnExpress account cooks fish with onion, fish sauce, salt, and pepper in măng chua as a soup. That soup is not the grill.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: The valley meal. Vietnam Airlines also names a cooking session for grilling stream fish with Thai hosts. A door was not printed.
seoTitle: Grilled stream fish in Pu Luong — leaves, then the coals
seoDescription: Cá suối nướng is small stream fish grilled with forest leaves. VnExpress also names a sour-bamboo fish soup. The price is Check on arrival.
